candidates.name: reaction_center_decomposition
candidates.hypothesis: On the pooled validation set, explicitly identifying transformed regions and preserved scaffold before answer generation will outperform direct prompting on cases where the main scaffold is mostly unchanged.

candidates.name: forward_roundtrip_check
candidates.hypothesis: On the pooled validation set, checking whether the proposed precursor set can plausibly regenerate the stated product will improve accuracy over a single draft, especially when the draft uses an incorrect leaving group or functional-group precursor.

candidates.name: fragment_completeness_audit
candidates.hypothesis: On the pooled validation set, auditing product-region coverage and precursor fragment completeness will improve accuracy over a single draft on answers with multiple reactants or small required fragments.
